cost_model=8
# kind|name|expected|source or native arguments; source rows decode \n.
# Comment lines are outside the fingerprint; they carry each row's reasoning.
#
# run: cost_used after running the source on a fresh State.
run|folded_literals|1|local x = 60 * 1000 + -5 local y = x * 2
run|literal_pow|4|local x = 2 ^ 10 local y = -3 ^ 2 + 1
run|loop_and_calls|100|local function f(a) return a + 1 end local s = 0 for i = 1, 100 do s = f(s) end
run|tables|296|local t = {} for i = 1, 50 do t[i] = i end local n = 0 for _, v in ipairs(t) do n = n + v end table.insert(t, 1, 0) table.concat(t, ',')
# One table creation and one flat rawset charge.
run|rawset|2|local t = {}; rawset(t, 1, 2)
run|strings_and_patterns|193|local s = 'hello world from lua' local a = s:find('wor') local b = s:gsub('o', '0') local c = s:match('(%a+) (%a+)') local u = s:upper()
run|gmatch|103|local n = 0 for w in string.gmatch('one two three four', '%a+') do n = n + #w end for w in string.gmatch('a b', '%a+') do n = n + 1 end
# The literal caret is charged as the one pattern byte it is, at creation and
# at first-call compilation.
run|gmatch_leading_caret|26|local n = 0 for w in string.gmatch('^a^a', '^a') do n = n + #w end
# Two tables, one initializer write, one handler add and one append.
run|sequence_len_handler|5|local t = setmetatable({}, {__len = function() local n = 1 return n + 1 end}) table.insert(t, 7)
# Two format bytes and one emitted decimal digit.
run|quoted_integral|3|local s = string.format('%q', 1)
# error: cost_used after a runtime type error, unbudgeted, at the exact budget
# and under a loose one. Every costed opcode that ran before the error counts,
# independent of the dispatch loop's batching interval.
# Two adds, including the failing one.
error|arith_error_after_add|2|local a, b = 1, nil local x = a + a local y = a + b
# One add; global writes and field reads are free.
error|index_nil_after_add|1|x = 2 local a = 1 + x local t = nil local b = t.k
# One add and the failing field write.
error|write_nil_after_add|2|local a = 1 local x = a + a local t = nil t.k = x
# One caller add, one successful callee add and one failing add.
error|nested_arith_error|3|local function f(a) local x = a + a return x + nil end local a = 1 local x = a + a f(x)
# 65 loop adds and the failing add, spanning the 64-unit batch boundary.
error|arith_error_after_batch_flush|66|local n = 0 for i = 1, 65 do n = n + 1 end return n + nil
# Two tables, one initializer write, one caller add and one failing add.
error|index_handler_error|5|local t = setmetatable({}, { __index = function(_, k) local n = 1 return n + k end }) local n = 1 local x = n + n local y = t.missing
# As above, plus the field write that invokes __newindex.
error|newindex_handler_error|6|local t = setmetatable({}, { __newindex = function(_, k, v) return v + k end }) local n = 1 local x = n + n t.missing = x
# Two tables, one initializer write, one caller add and one failing add.
error|length_handler_error|5|local t = setmetatable({}, { __len = function(t) local n = 1 return n + t end }) local n = 1 local x = n + n local y = #t
# Table library sources; insert, remove and pack add a flat 1, unpack is free.

run|unpack_missing_values|1|unpack({}, 1, 10)
run|table_unpack_missing_values|1|table.unpack({}, 1, 10)

run|concat_empty|2|return table.concat({}, '')
run|concat_empty_separator|2|return table.concat({}, 'x')
run|concat_values|7|return table.concat({'a', 'b'}, '')
run|concat_separator|10|return table.concat({'a', 'bb'}, ',')
failure|concat_invalid_value|9|return table.concat({'a', false, 'bb'}, ',')
# pin: a named value a specialized test reads through `pinned_cost`; the last
# column names the consuming test. Most are cost deltas between two runs, not
# absolute costs of one source.
pin|gmatch_subject_doubling|1152|string_charges::gmatch_full_scan_is_linear_in_its_subject

pin|matcher_refusal|17|string_charges::matcher_refusal_is_a_budget_error_at_the_exact_budget

# free and free_error: functions docs/budget.md documents as free. The source
# runs with one empty table as its vararg and must leave cost_used at 0;
# free_error must raise its script error. The expected column stays empty.
free|_G.type||return type(nil)
free|_G.tonumber||return tonumber('1')
free|_G.tostring||return tostring(1)
free|_G.print||print()
free|_G.select||return select('#', 1, 2)
free|_G.next||return next(...)
free|_G.pairs||return pairs(...)
free|_G.ipairs||local iter, t, k = ipairs(...) return iter(t, k)
free|_G.getmetatable||return getmetatable(...)
free|_G.setmetatable||return setmetatable(..., nil)
free|_G.rawget||return rawget(..., 1)
free|_G.rawequal||return rawequal(1, 1)
free|_G.rawlen||return rawlen(...)
free|_G.unpack||return unpack(...)
free|table.unpack||return table.unpack(...)
free_error|_G.error||error('cost probe')
